case_title.reason: Matches the case title given in the judgment header.

number_of_accused.reason: One respondent (the Commandant) faced the GCM and the appeals concern him alone.

accused_gender.reason: The judgment refers to the Commandant as 'he' and 'his' throughout.

accused_age.reason: Only superannuation is mentioned; no age in years is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community is mentioned.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment describes him as Commandant of 227 Company ASC (Supply), an Army officer.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on wealth or class is made.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior record is mentioned in the judgment.

victim_gender.reason: The offence is against the government and no individual victim is identified, so victimless is supported.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Only official superior-subordinate roles are described; no personal relationship with a victim is stated.

offence_category.correct_value: Cheating/Fraud (charge 1, intent to defraud); other charges are military discipline offences
offence_category.quote: the first charge was an offence falling under section 52(f) of the Act which provides that ... any person who does anything with intent to defraud
offence_category.reason: 'Other' ignores that the lead charge is an intent-to-defraud offence closer to Cheating/Fraud.

statutory_provisions.reason: Judgment cites Army Act ss.52(f), 63, 71 and Pension Regulation 16(a), matching the value.

weapon.reason: No weapon is involved in the charges.

evidence_type.reason: Judgment notes 13 prosecution witnesses, documentary exhibits, material objects and the inspection findings.

confession.correct_value: Oral remark and confidential report (15.2.1990) recorded as an admission-type statement; relied on by prosecution to found charge 1
confession.quote: Making of the said remark has been interpreted as respondent no.1 accepting meat from the contractor with heart as part of the dressed meat
confession.reason: Value says 'None', but the accused's remark was the basis of charge 1 and could count as an admission.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating facts are noted; the court found the punishment disproportionate.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: Limited role, technical charges, subordinates' lapses, over 20 years old and superannuation are all noted.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: GCM found guilty of charges 1, 4 and 5(c), not guilty of charges 2 and 3; sentenced to dismissal from service
trial_court_outcome.quote: the GCM found the first respondent not guilty of the second and third charges, but guilty of the first charge, fourth charge and item (c) of the fifth charge
trial_court_outcome.reason: Verdicts and dismissal are right, but pension forfeiture was a later President's order, not the trial court's outcome.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court partly allowed the writ, upheld GCM findings and dismissal, and quashed the pension forfeiture order.

final_outcome.reason: Findings of guilt were left intact but the punishment was substituted, which fits conviction_modified.

offence_finally_established.reason: Court upheld findings on charges 1, 4 and 5(c), under ss.52(f) and 63.

imprisonment_type.reason: Substituted punishment is forfeiture of eight years' service and severe reprimand; no imprisonment is imposed.

imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed-term imprisonment is imposed, so null is correct.

neutral_facts.reason: Covers the incident, inspection and evidence in about 265 words without names or court outcome; the contract-interpretation dispute is presented as the prosecution case.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment states ten years maximum under s.52(f) and seven years under s.63; no minimum is stated.

attempt_completion.reason: The offences were completed acts or omissions.

physical_harm.reason: No injury or death is involved.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 2 charged (ss.52(f) and 63); 2 finally upheld (charges 1, 4 and 5(c) under those sections)
number_of_offences.quote: Section 52(f) and section 63 are very broadly and generally worded and deal with residuary offences
number_of_offences.reason: Instruction counts sections, not charges; the value's '5 charges' and '3 findings' do not follow that format.

financial_property_loss.reason: No monetary or property loss amount is stated in the judgment.

premeditation_planning.reason: No premeditation or planning finding is made.

motive.reason: Intent to defraud the government is the alleged motive, and the court found at best a wrong interpretation of clause 86.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Inspection figures, the recorded remark and the subordinates' responsibility are the evidence the court relied on.

witness_credibility.reason: Court expressly declined to re-assess evidence and did not assess credibility.

post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment notes the remark was reiterated in the confidential report dated 15.2.1990.

trial_duration.reason: Dates for the offence, GCM trial start and sentence, High Court and Supreme Court judgment all match the text.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for both sides match the judgment's appearance listing.

investigation_status.reason: Inspection, subordinates' charge-sheeting, charge-sheet of 30.12.1992 and GCM trial are all stated.

procedural_irregularity.reason: Court found no procedural irregularity; the Presiding Officer disqualification plea was rejected.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: dismissal 30.7.1993. High Court: writ partly allowed. Supreme Court: Crl.A. 876/2003 allowed; Crl.A. 877/2003 allowed, dismissal substituted by forfeiture of eight years' service and reprimand
appeal_history.quote: We allow Criminal Appeal No.877 of 2003 filed by the first respondent
appeal_history.reason: Court allowed Crl.A. 877/2003 outright; 'allowed in part' mislabels the disposal, though the substitution is right.

prosecution_argument.reason: Appellants' challenge to the High Court's quashing of the Regulation 16(a) pension order is supported.

defence_argument.reason: Rule 39(2)(c) disqualification and bias challenge are stated; proportionality challenge is also reflected in the appeal.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Limited judicial review of court martial, proportionality test and Regulation 16(a) independence are applied in the judgment.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: P.D. Yadav, Major A. Hussain, Ranjit Thakur (relied on), R.K. Sharma (referred) and Brig. A.K. Malhotra (reversed) match the case reference list.

sentencing_rationale.reason: Disproportionality, remand not pursued due to age of matter and superannuation are all stated.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Technical nature, limited role, subordinates' lapses and superannuation were weighed by the court.

other_sentence_order.reason: Pension order set aside, pension to be settled within six months, and no back wages are all ordered.
